Communication · 02

Optimize your leaders' voice, subject by subject.

An executive who speaks commits the brand. You still need to know on which subjects they are expected, against which peers, and in front of which audiences. We measure their share of voice subject by subject, to focus their voice where it counts.

Book a meeting →

The questions we answer

  • On which subjects is our leader credible to the public?
  • How do they compare with our competitors' leaders?
  • Which formats and platforms give them the most resonance?
  • Where does their voice add noise rather than meaning?

What you get

  • Share of voice per spokesperson, topic by topic, against a peer set.
  • The map of subjects where the voice is expected, and those to avoid.
  • The relays that amplify their messages.
  • A six-month speaking plan.

What we read

  • LinkedInPosts, reactions and who relays them.
  • Business pressInterviews, quotes and their pick-ups.
  • X and podcastsThe debates where the leader is quoted or expected.
  • Peer setComparable leaders in your sector.

How we go about it

  1. 01Framing

    We agree the peer set and the strategic subjects with you.

  2. 02Collection

    We collect the statements and what they got people saying, over twelve months.

  3. 03Analysis

    An analyst measures share of voice and tone, subject by subject.

  4. 04Decision

    We propose an editorial plan: which subjects, which formats, which relays.

An example

Illustrative example: a CEO posts every week about innovation, with little echo. The read shows their audience expects them on jobs and regional industry, where their peers are absent. Recommendation: refocus their voice on those two subjects.

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with the leader's communication team?

Yes: we give them a read and recommendations, they keep control of the messages.

Can you follow several spokespeople?

Yes, up to a whole executive committee, with the same method.

Is it useful in a crisis?

That is exactly when knowing what the leader is expected to address avoids missteps.
